title: Galax-z v12
description: Galax-z v11 with the Quindar tones in place of TE's start sound, not after it.
notes: When the OP-Z is switched on, the two Quindar tones are its start sound; TE's is not played any more.
disable_start_sound in the OP-Z's general.json turns the tones off too. Galax-z v12 quiet is the same with no start sound at all.
